about: Upper Dardenne Creek drains about 48 square miles, 95% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 870 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 500 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Dardenne Creek, Little Dardenne Creek, Cunningham Branch and Kraut Run. St. Charles County communities here include O'Fallon, New Melle and Lake St. Louis. Downstream, its water passes through the Middle Dardenne Creek, Lower Dardenne Creek and Cuivre Island-Mississippi River watersheds on its way down the Mississippi River.
